{{Quote
|From the outset, theirs was a hopeless task. Those wild lands could never be replicated within a space so artificial.
|[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]
|Hr = Hornet
}}

The <b>Materium</b> is an [[Items (Silksong)|item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It can be used to display various items and materials in Hornet's [[Bellhome]].

== Use ==
After [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] acquires the Materium, it can be brought to the [[Bellhome]] and assembled to be used to record various Materials and Mementos Hornet has found throughout her journey.

If both the Materium and the Desk are installed, then the two furnishings combine, allowing the Desk's [[Items (Silksong)#Tradables|Relics]] and [[Psalm Cylinder]]s to be viewable in the same window as the Materium's Materials and Mementos.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Bellhome.png!Location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Bellhart 09.png!Materium in Bellhome in Bellhart
}}

== How to Acquire ==
The Materium can be found in the upper part of the [[Memorium]], in the room before the room containing the [[Voltvessels]].

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Materium.png!Location in the Memorium
| Image2 = Screenshot SS Materium 01.png!Materium in the Memorium
}}

|-

| align="center" | Western [[Whiteward]].
|-

[[File:SS Materium footer.png|center|400px]]

== Trivia ==
* As there are four Hearts to acquire ([[Encrusted Heart]], [[Pollen Heart]], [[Hunter's Heart]] and [[Conjoined Heart]]) but only three are needed to enter [[Red Memory]], the final unused Heart is instead displayed as the last Memento.
** If Hornet has all four Hearts before delving into the Red Memory, the Encrusted, Pollen, and Hunter's Heart take priority, leaving the Conjoined Heart to be used as a Memento.
** If Hornet is substituting the Conjoined Heart for one of the other three to dive into Red Memory, the remaining Heart can still be collected afterwards and is used as a Memento.
* The [[Farsight]] displays empty entries for items that have not been seen.
** The [[Flintgem]]s, [[Crown Fragment]], [[Pilgrim Shawl]]s, and [[Roach Guts]] are missable items and do not create empty entries if they were not obtained.
